# ABC Design (`@abc-design/*`) — Full LLM & AI Agent Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

Version: 0.1.0
Packages (5 workspace packages):
1. `@abc-design/tokens` — 3-tier semantic CSS custom properties (`--abc-*`), 6 brand palettes (`blue`, `indigo`, `violet`, `emerald`, `amber`, `rose`), 3 densities (`compact`, `default`, `comfortable`), 4 radii (`none`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`), 4 control sizes (`xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`), 4 motion presets (`none`, `subtle`, `smooth`, `spring`), View Transitions theme engine.
2. `@abc-design/core` — Zero-dependency pure TypeScript headless logic kernel:
   - `pinyin`: `getCharInitial`, `getPinyinInitials`, `matchKeywordWithPinyin`
   - `tree`: `computeTreeCheckState`, `toggleTreeNodeChecked`, `filterTreeNodes`, `collectAllExpandableKeys`, `normalizeTreeSelectData`, `resolveTreeCheckedStateFromValue`, `formatTreeCheckedStrategy`, `filterTreeSelectNodes`, `flattenVisibleTreeNodes`
   - `table`: `filterAndSortClientRows`, `cleanQueryObject`, `readQueryFromUrlSearch`, `writeQueryToUrlSearch`
   - `calendar`: `formatIsoDate`, `buildCalendarMonthGrid`
   - `queryBuilder`: `getOperatorsForFieldType`, `getRuleOperatorMeta`, `createDefaultCondition`, `createDefaultRuleGroup`, `evaluateRuleGroup`, `formatRuleGroupSummary`
   - `diff`: `computeObjectDiff` (auto secret masking), `computeLineDiff` (LCS line diff with line numbers)
   - `keyValue`: `parseKeyValueText` (auto-detects JSON / `.env` / HTTP headers), `serializeKeyValueEntries`, `findDuplicateKeys`
3. `@abc-design/react` — Zero-business-coupled enterprise UI library (340+ runtime exports, 240+ component & compound primitives): `<AbcProvider>`, 5-mode `<ProLayout>`, `<PageHeader>`/`<HubNavBar>`/`<PageSection>`/`<ProPageHeader>`, `<TreeSelect>`/`<Cascader>`/`<Transfer>`/`<FileUpload>`/`<KeyValueInput>`, `<Table>`/`<TableCore>`/`<DataTable>`/`<ProTable>`/`<EditableProTable>`, `<ProConfigForm>`/`<ProFormLayout>`/`<ProStepsForm>`/`<ProFormDependency>`/`<ProFormList>`, `<FilterBuilder>` (`<RuleBuilder>`)/`<SavedFilterViews>`/`<ActiveFilterBar>`, `<ResizableSplitPane>`/`<ProSplitWorkbench>`/`<SplitDetailPanel>`/`<InspectorPanel>`, `<ConfigDiffViewer>`/`<BatchActionTracker>`, `<Watermark>`/`<PermissionGuard>`/`<TabErrorBoundary>`.
4. `@abc-design/charts` — Tree-shaken ECharts 5 theme/resize-adaptive `<AbcChart>` (`<Chart>`), `<StatCard>`, `getAbcChartPalette`, `buildAbcBaseChartOption`.
5. `@abc-design/markdown` — Standalone dual-pane `<MarkdownEditor>` wrapping `@uiw/react-md-editor`, synced automatically with `<AbcProvider>` `resolvedTheme`, exposes `MarkdownEditorHandle` (`insertText`, `focus`).

================================================================================
SECTION 1: INSTALLATION & CSS INTEGRATION
================================================================================

Install:
```bash
pnpm add @abc-design/tokens @abc-design/core @abc-design/react lucide-react
# Optional add-ons:
pnpm add @abc-design/charts echarts
pnpm add @abc-design/markdown @uiw/react-md-editor
```

CSS Mode A (Standard Vite / Next.js / Webpack without Tailwind v4):
```tsx
import '@abc-design/react/styles.css'
// If using @abc-design/markdown: it bundles its CSS in dist or import '@abc-design/markdown/styles.css'
```

CSS Mode B (Host uses Tailwind CSS v4):
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@abc-design/tokens/styles/index.css";

@source "../../node_modules/@abc-design/react/dist/**/*.js";
@source "../../node_modules/@abc-design/charts/dist/**/*.js";
```

CSS Mode C (Host uses legacy Tailwind CSS v3 + `@abc-design/react/styles.css`):
CRITICAL: Unlayered v3 `.hidden` overrides `@abc-design/react/styles.css` `@layer utilities` breakpoints (`md:block`, `md:flex`) and hides `ProLayout` desktop navigation unless the v3 host scans abc-design dist AND wraps `@tailwind base` inside `@layer base`:
```js
// tailwind.config.js
content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{ts,tsx}', './node_modules/@abc-design/react/dist/**/*.js', './node_modules/@abc-design/charts/dist/**/*.js']
```

================================================================================
SECTION 2: ROOT PROVIDER, 5 ADAPTERS & CONFIG HOOK (`@abc-design/react`)
================================================================================

```tsx
import { AbcProvider, useAbcConfig } from '@abc-design/react'

<AbcProvider
  defaultTheme={{ mode: 'system', brand: 'blue', density: 'default', radius: 'md', componentSize: undefined, motion: 'smooth' }}
  defaultPageTransition="fade-slide" // 'fade-slide' | 'fade' | 'zoom' | 'slide-left' | 'none'
  defaultDrawerCascadeMode="adjacent" // 'stack' | 'adjacent'
  watermarkText={['Internal Console', 'Confidential']}
  defaultWatermarkEnabled={false}
  uploadAdapter={async (file: File): Promise<string> => uploadedUrl}
  dictAdapter={async (dictCode: string) => options} // Array<{ label, value, tone?, disabled? }>
  permissionAdapter={(permission: string | string[], mode: 'any' | 'all' = 'any'): boolean => true}
  captchaAdapter={async () => ({ nonceStr, blockSrc, blockY, canvasSrc })}
  toastAdapter={{ success, error, info, warning }} // optional: built-in AbcToastViewport if omitted
>
  {children}
</AbcProvider>

// Read config in child components:
const { theme, resolvedTheme, setBrand, setComponentSize, setMotion, toggleTheme, toast } = useAbcConfig()
// CRITICAL: Property is `resolvedTheme` ('light' | 'dark'), NOT `resolvedColorScheme`.
```

================================================================================
SECTION 3: 5-MODE PROLAYOUT, PAGE CHROME & ROUTER WIRING
================================================================================

```tsx
import { ProLayout, PageContainer, PageHeader, HubNavBar, hubNavTabClassName, PageSection, type AbcMenuItem } from '@abc-design/react'

const menus: AbcMenuItem[] = [
  { key: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', path: '/dashboard', icon: 'LayoutDashboard' },
  {
    key: 'system',
    label: 'System',
    icon: 'Settings',
    children: [
      { key: 'users', label: 'Users', path: '/system/users', icon: 'Users' },
      { key: 'roles', label: 'Roles', path: '/system/roles', icon: 'ShieldCheck' },
    ],
  },
]

<ProLayout
  brand={{ name: 'Acme Enterprise', subtitle: 'Multi-Tenant SaaS', logo: '<svg ...>...</svg>', onEditBrand: () => {} }}
  menuItems={menus}
  pathname={location.pathname}
  onNavigate={(path) => navigate(path)}
  defaultSettings={{ mode: 'sidebar', sidebarTone: 'dark', showTabs: true, keepAlive: true, contentWidth: 'fluid' }}
  headerExtra={<TenantSwitcher />}
>
  <PageContainer title="Users" subtitle="Manage enterprise accounts">
    {pageContent}
  </PageContainer>
</ProLayout>
```

================================================================================
SECTION 4: EXACT COMPONENT SIGNATURES & ANTI-HALLUCINATION RULES
================================================================================

1. `Button`: `variant?: 'primary'|'secondary'|'outline'|'danger'|'success'|'warning'|'ghost'|'text'|'default'|'destructive'|'link'`, `size?: 'xs'|'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'default'|'icon'|'icon-sm'`, `motion?: AbcMotionPreset`, `loading?: boolean`, `loadingText?: ReactNode`, `leftIcon`/`rightIcon`, `iconOnly?: boolean`, `block?: boolean`, `asChild?: boolean`.
2. `Input` & `Textarea`: `onChange: (e: ChangeEvent) => void`; `clearable`/`allowClear`, `passwordToggle`, `showCount`, `label`, `error`, `helperText`.
3. `InputNumber` / `ByteQuotaInput` / `DurationQuotaInput`: `onChange: (val: number | null) => void` (quota inputs pass `number`). NOTE: Quota input `size` only accepts `'sm' | 'default'`.
4. `Select` & `DictSelect` & `SelectField`:
   - `Select`: When `options` are provided, `onChange(val)` receives VALUE directly (`string | number` or array when `multiple`). `size?: ControlSize | 'ghost'`.
   - `SelectField`: Convenience wrapper with `onValueChange: (val: string) => void`.
   - `RadixSelect`: Compound API `<RadixSelect value onValueChange><SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent><SelectGroup><SelectLabel /><SelectItem value="a">A</SelectItem><SelectSeparator /></SelectGroup></SelectContent></RadixSelect>`.
5. `TreeSelect` & `TreeSelectField` & `Cascader`:
   - `TreeSelect`: `treeData`, `fieldNames`, `treeDataSimpleMode`, `treeCheckable`, `treeCheckStrictly`, `showCheckedStrategy` (`TreeSelect.SHOW_PARENT | SHOW_CHILD | SHOW_ALL`), `selectableLeafOnly`, `maxTagCount`, `searchable`, `allowClear`, `loadData`, `virtual`, `listHeight`, `onChange(value, labelList, extra)`.
   - `Cascader`: `options`, `value`, `onChange`, `multiple`, `changeOnSelect`, `searchable`, `clearable`.
6. `Checkbox` & `Switch`: `onChange: (checked: boolean) => void`.
7. `Divider`: Middle title prop is `label?: ReactNode` (NOT `children`), `orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'`.
8. `Alert` vs `NotificationBanner`: `Alert.tone` uses `'info'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'`, whereas `NotificationBanner.variant` & `ToastCard.variant` use `'info'|'success'|'warning'|'error'`.
9. `Dialog` vs `Drawer` vs `ProFormContainer` Modal Routing Rule:
   - `Drawer`: Mandatory for large/complex forms & cascaded sub-forms (`cascadeMode="adjacent" | "stack"`).
   - `Dialog`: Native `<dialog>` Top Layer for small forms (1–3 fields) & confirmations.
   - `ProFormContainer`: Prop is `mode?: 'drawer' | 'modal'` (NOT `'dialog'`).
   - `HubNavBar`: `badgeTone?: 'indigo' | 'slate' | 'primary' | 'dark'`, tabs use `hubNavTabClassName(active, variant)`.
10. `@abc-design/charts` vs `@abc-design/react` `StatCard`: Charts `<StatCard title value trend loading />` uses `title`, whereas React `<StatCard label value hint badge tone />` uses `label`; Charts exports `<AbcChart option height loading empty onEvents={{ click: fn }} />`, `getAbcChartPalette(brand, isDark)`, `buildAbcBaseChartOption(option, brand, isDark)`.

================================================================================
SECTION 5: 12 COMPLEX LINKAGE & ORCHESTRATION COMPONENTS (`@abc-design/react`)
================================================================================

Use these built-in orchestrators instead of hand-writing glue code (`apps/playground/src/pages/linkage/*`, `docs/agent/05-complex-linkage-and-orchestration.md`):

1. `ResizableSplitPane`: Drag/keyboard-accessible (`role="separator"`, Arrow keys +/-16px, Home/End, double-click reset) horizontal/vertical split container with `storageKey` persistence and `collapsible` toggle.
   - Props: `direction?: 'horizontal'|'vertical'`, `defaultSize`, `size`, `onSizeChange`, `minSize`, `maxSize`, `collapsible`, `collapsed`, `onCollapsedChange`, `storageKey`, `firstPane`, `secondPane`.
2. `ProSplitWorkbench`: Left `Tree` (with pinyin search, `counts` badges, "All" shortcut returning `null`) + center table workspace + right `SplitDetailLayout` inline detail drawer.
   - Props: `treeData`, `counts`, `allLabel`, `allCount`, `selectedKey`, `onSelectKey`, `sidebarWidth`, `detailPanel`, `detailOpen`, `detailWidth`, `detailExpanded`, `children`.
3. `ProFormProvider` / `useProFormContext` / `ProFormDependency`: Subscribes selectively to `deps: string[]` on `ProFormInstance`, auto-clears `resetFieldsOnChange: string[]`, runs debounced `asyncLoader(depValues, abortSignal)` cancelling stale requests on rapid change.
4. `ProFormList`: Dynamic array subform rows (`variant?: 'card' | 'inline'`), `initialItem`, `minItems`, `maxItems`, `copyable`, `sortable` (moveUp/moveDown), `rowValidator`, `summaryRender`, binds `form`+`name` or controlled `value`/`onChange`.
5. `KeyValueInput`: Key-value pair editor using `@abc-design/core` (`findDuplicateKeys`, `parseKeyValueText`, `serializeKeyValueEntries`). Supports row enable toggle (`allowEnableToggle`), secret masking toggle (`allowSecretMask`), duplicate key alerts, and live `.env` / HTTP `headers` / `json` bulk text round-trip (`allowBulkEdit`).
6. `EditableProTable<T>`: Inline editable data grid (`mode?: 'row' | 'table'`) with `'text' | 'number' | 'select' | 'switch' | 'date'` cell editors + `renderEditor`, cross-column `validator(value, row, rows)`, dirty badge detection, `recordCreatorProps` (`position: 'top'|'bottom'`), `deletable`, `summaryRender`, `onSaveRow`.
7. `FilterBuilder` (alias `RuleBuilder`): Nested `AND` / `OR` / `NOT` rule AST builder driven by `@abc-design/core/queryBuilder` (`AbcRuleFieldSchema[]`). Changing `field` automatically resets incompatible `operator` & right-hand value; changing `operator` adapts right input slot by `arity` (0 = hidden, 1 = single/multi control, 2 = range `between`). Filter rows client-side via `evaluateRuleGroup(record, group, fields)`.
8. `SavedFilterViews<TFilter>`: Named filter view pill bar with `builtIn` lock protection, dirty badge (`isDirty` vs deep comparison), inline save-as & update custom views, and optional `storageKey` persistence.
9. `ActiveFilterBar`: Unified active filter chip bar displaying filter sources (`'chart' | 'toolbar' | 'table' | 'tree' | 'rule' | 'custom'`), `filteredCount`/`totalCount` summary, per-chip removal, and `onClearAll`. Designed to pair with `<AbcChart onEvents={{ click }} />` for dashboard cross-filtering.
10. `ProStepsForm<T>`: Multi-step wizard (`steps`, `initialValues`, `onFinish`, `stepsDirection?: 'horizontal'|'vertical'`). Each step supports sync/async `validate(values)` (disables button with `loading` during async check, displays `<Alert tone="danger" />` on block), preserves draft state when navigating back.
11. `ConfigDiffViewer`: Before/after review component powered by `@abc-design/core/diff`. Props: `before`, `after`, `beforeCode`, `afterCode`, `labels`, `mode?: 'fields'|'code'|'tabs'`, `codeLayout?: 'unified'|'split'`, `onlyChanges`, `maskSecrets`. Auto-masks secrets/tokens and shows `+Added / ~Modified / -Removed` badges.
12. `BatchActionTracker`: Real-time batch execution monitor (`variant?: 'inline'|'floating'`), `ProgressBar`, status filter pills (`queued`/`running`/`succeeded`/`failed`), per-item error details, `onRetryItem(id)`, and `onRetryFailed(failedIds)` for bulk retry of failed records.
13. `SortableList<T>` & `SortableSplitEditor<T>` (+ `@abc-design/core` `arrayMove`, `isOrderDirty`, `reconcileStagedOrder`): Compresses tall multi-card forms (e.g., payment gateways, routing rules) into compact 1-line draggable rows (`GripVertical` pointer capture + gap drop marker + `Space`/Arrow/Esc keyboard reorder + `role="status"` live region), stages reordered items locally with top-bar `Save order` / `Reset order` (`onSaveOrder`), and opens `SplitDetailPanel` inline on the right for editing or `allowCreate` creation.
